p0-w5.question: At the regime pH and potential (E vs SHE at the Al open-circuit potential), and at the bulk Ca2+ activity and dissolved carbonate of each design point, is calcite (or ACC) the equilibrium state of Ca and C(IV), how far above that equilibrium does it sit per atom, and is the native Al oxide the equilibrium state of Al? (thermodynamic proxies; no rates)
p0-w5.scope: Thermodynamic proxies only: a stability domain, a decomposition energy or a window says which state is at equilibrium, never how fast anything corrodes, dissolves or decomposes.

conditions.a_CO3_note: a_CO3 = alpha2(pH) C_T (ideal solution, closed C(IV) system); it varies along the pH axis, so the scalar is null
conditions.carbon: C(IV) only; exact speciation per pH column for calcite and ACC; predominance convention for the domain map
